column1: # w3-bin.tsv (harbor#961, lane E): the mapping for the unwired bin/ PR; "decide" rows are not imported
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The six-wave rename needs one reviewed table per wave before any file moves; the operator approves it wholesale at sitting B
# (SITTING-B.md lists only the rows that need a decision). Names come from registered terms only (standards/naming/terms.tsv).
# COLUMNS  old_path TAB new_path TAB wave TAB recommendation TAB confidence TAB reason TAB remove_by TAB frozen TAB surface TAB reader
#   recommendation  rename (imported) or decide (a question in SITTING-B.md; the importer skips it)
#   confidence      high, med or low; low rows are asked in SITTING-B.md
#   remove_by       the date the old name stops working. The importer ignores this column and writes "-": set it after the import (sitting-b.md has the command).
#                   "-" here means no outside reader was found, a case-only move (a forwarder would be the file itself) or an internal constant (plain rename, no dual-read window)
#   frozen          the frozen.tsv name this row touches (a stranger types it); such a row keeps an alias until remove_by
#   surface         empty = bin or path (the importer picks); env and rule-id are not file moves

#   reader          what outside the repo reads the old path (hook command, loaded LaunchAgent, deployed copy, PATH link, another repo, a memory note, frozen.tsv); "none found" means remove_by is - and no symlink is left. Checked 2026-10-27.
